essays.assessment: No major defect found by either accepted reviewer. Two focused literature comparisons.

Distinction between historical evidence, actual entitlement and binding procedural rules.

essays.title: Difference without Reconstruction
essays.assessment: Both new independent reviewers: NO_MAJOR_DEFECT_FOUND. Argument review has no findings; literature review has one demonstrated minor omission.

required_before_submission.location: Why holism does not close this route; treatment of recollections as evidence; bibliography
required_before_submission.change: Add Andonovski2022, Episodic Representation: A Mental Models Account, and a short comparison. His simplified episodic event models support inference without recreating every detail. This essay instead concerns a mapping between whole phenomenal types and the precise conditions for inferring original difference.
required_before_submission.reason: Directly relevant predecessor is omitted. No duplication or failure of the conditional result was established.

recommended_editorial_clarifications.change: Replace the absolute-sounding prohibition on a domain selected after seeing the contrast with a requirement for independent justification. Later independent validation can count; selecting a domain merely to guarantee the wanted result cannot.
recommended_editorial_clarifications.status: Interpretive question raised by reviewer; coordinator recommends a small clarification, not repair of a demonstrated defect.

recommended_editorial_clarifications.change: State once near the opening, in simple language, that the result removes a logical prohibition but does not certify real memory. Compress repeated disclaimers while preserving the distinctions about noise, observation, feature attribution and comparison routes.
recommended_editorial_clarifications.status: Coordinator presentation recommendation; the present manuscript already acknowledges these limits.

optional: Add a short general structural-representation antecedent, O’Brien–Opie, if useful; do not burden the essay with every adjacent work found.
Use an explicitly hypothetical everyday example to make difference-without-reconstruction intuitive; do not present it as an experiment.
Mention Koksvik/Fürst only where it helps identify the surviving alternative-explanation burden.
preserve: Whole-type relationships need not be preserved phenomenal parts.
Unequal outputs imply unequal inputs only under the justified no-manufactured-difference condition.
Matching outputs need a further condition; there is no universal privilege for positive contrast.
Same distribution is not same individual output; noisy evidence requires a separate model.
Two recollections versus perception–recollection remain different routes.
The strong reconstruction requirement is challenged; the weaker uncalibrated-memory objection survives.
Warrant for observing output phenomenal difference and attributing an original difference to cognition remains outside the result.
not_required: A new experiment proving actual memory satisfies the model
An empirical calibration result as a condition of retaining the explicitly logical essay
A general metaphysics of experience or a new mathematical theorem
remaining_uncertainty: Full Swoyer1991 text was inaccessible; detailed overlap is not resolved.
The finite search found no prior presentation of the complete combination; originality is not certified.
